creative_intent: Focus on a clean matte B4C technical ceramic material study, preserving the exact form and silhouette of a manufactured object with minimal transformation.

must_have: Clear, readable contours of a single manufactured object
Distinct silhouette of an engineered component
exactly one manufactured object as the clear subject
visible contour evidence such as edge, rim, bevel, seam, or curvature
material visibly attached to the object, not floating as texture
visible edge, rim, bevel, seam, or contour evidence
material visibly attached to the object

composition.framing: Single manufactured object centered, filling the frame appropriately for a material study
composition.background: Clean, neutral, non-distracting background to emphasize the subject and material

lighting.style: Even, studio lighting to highlight material properties without harsh shadows
constraints: No dramatic or abstract lighting; focus on material clarity
color must remain subordinate to material identity
color must follow form then material, never override them
no flat color, always material texture variation
pure white and pure black are forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones

core_risks: Drift into abstract or texture-only compositions
Material misinterpretation (e.g., appearing as plaster or glossy plastic)
Failure to maintain exact form and silhouette
material misread as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
anti_drift_rules: Maintain a clear, singular manufactured object as the subject
Ensure the B4C technical ceramic material is the dominant visual element
Prevent any atmospheric or abstract elements from obscuring the object or material
Strictly adhere to the matte, dry, dense surface finish
always preserve one clearly readable manufactured object
do not let texture or atmosphere become the subject
keep material identity locked and explicit
form -> material -> color priority is mandatory
do not allow neon, pure white, pure black, or plastic-clean RGB drift
crimson may appear only as restrained seam/core accent when applicable
do not allow abstract, texture-only, or atmosphere-first subject drift
keep material identity explicit and stable
success_criteria: A clearly identifiable manufactured object made of clean matte B4C technical ceramic
The material exhibits a dry, dense, engineered surface
The object's silhouette and form are preserved and readable
Absence of any forbidden material reads or abstract elements
image does not collapse into abstract texture or atmosphere
color feels subtractive and pigment-like, never RGB-clean
shadow mass dominates and color remains materially grounded
image does not read as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
direction_summary: Generate a clear, medium shot of a single manufactured object, focusing on its clean matte B4C technical ceramic material. Preserve the object's exact form and silhouette, ensuring a dry, dense, engineered surface read, free from any abstract or forbidden material interpretations.
